lines.text: The writer thanks Christ Jesus for appointing him to service, though he was once a blasphemer, persecutor, and violent man.
The grace of our Lord overflowed to the writer, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
Christ Jesus came to save sinners, and the writer was shown mercy so Jesus could display His perfect patience.
The writer praises the King eternal, immortal, and invisible, then entrusts Timothy with a command matching earlier visions about him.
